description: Angular component class for configuring value card widget settings in the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, validation, and preview functions.

classes.name: ValueCardWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing the settings of a value card widget, including form controls, validation, and preview functions.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: onWidgetConfigSet
methods.description: Initializes component state based on widget configuration parameters.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Provides default widget settings based on current configuration.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided widget settings.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form controls that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current form state and layout.

methods.name: _valuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a sample value for preview based on current configuration.

methods.name: _datePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a formatted date string for preview based on current date format settings.
